title: Crate: crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal (the TUI). Goal: fix low-quality image previews correctly by rendering real images vi…

items.content: Switch FilterType::Triangle to Lanczos3 in image_preview.rs (both resize calls), adjust tests
Add stable id (AtomicU32) and graphics_png (cached PNG bytes) to ImagePreview; expose id() and graphics_png()
Create src/graphics.rs: Protocol enum, detect(), wire-format fns (transmit/place/delete/move_cursor), GraphicsState with sync()
Add visible_image_placements() on App and detail_view_rect tracking for the image detail view
Add GraphicsState to Terminal; call graphics.sync() in the post-draw step in terminal.rs::run()
Add unit tests: graphics.rs (detect, escape builders, GraphicsState diffing), image_preview.rs (id uniqueness, graphics_png presence)
Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test -p aura-ui-terminal; fix any issues
